newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BA on Australia army project shortlist.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BA on Australia army project shortlist.

text.p: Britsh Aerospace Plc is one of three companies on a shortlist for the supply of the Bushranger lightly armoured infantry mobility vehicles project, Australian Defence Minister Ian McLachlan said on Friday.
McLachlan said Australian Specialised Vehicle Systems, British Aerospace Australia, and Perry Engineering had been chosen for trials commencing in early 1997.

"The competitive trial process will allow the Australian Defence Force to select the most effective vehicle after comparing the performance of each vehicle over a wide range of conditions," he said in a statement.
The value of the project to supply the Australian army with 300 to 600 vehicles has been estimated at around A$250 million.

McLachlan said the vehicles would provide cross-country and off-road mobility to Australia's frontline soldiers allowing them to move quickly over the vast distances of Australia's north and provide a degree of protection against small arms fire, mines and grenades.
A final decision on the bids was expected to be made in mid-1998, with delivery planned to commence in early 2000, he said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
